summary: First iteration end-to-end testing for Lakshmi Venkateswara Fast Foods MVP. All 6 backend pytest cases pass (root, menu, reservation create+persist, missing fields 422, blank fields 400, list reservations). All 12 requested frontend flows pass: hero, navbar, 7 menu cards with prices, concierge map + beacon + info rows, reservation empty-submit error toast, and reservation success POST returning 200 with success toast. No console errors observed.

issues: Date and time inputs use the browser's native pickers (mm/dd/yyyy, 07:30 PM) instead of a shadcn Calendar/Time picker. Visually inconsistent with the luxury aesthetic of the rest of the page.

Words 'The', 'Culinary', 'Sanctuary' render with no whitespace in the accessible text node ('TheCulinarySanctuary.') because each line is wrapped in a span with no separating space. Visually fine due to block layout, but harms screen-reader pronunciation and copy-paste.

action_items: Optional: replace native date/time inputs in Reservation.jsx with shadcn Calendar + custom time selector for visual consistency.
Optional: add a non-breaking space or whitespace between hero headline span lines so accessible text reads 'The Culinary Sanctuary.'
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/reservations correctly validates required fields (returns 400 for blank, 422 for missing) and persists with UUID id and status='pending'.
MongoDB _id properly excluded from list endpoints via projection {'_id': 0}.
All env vars sourced correctly (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
test_credentials: N/A — public single-page site with no auth.
seed_data_creation: Created reservation 'TEST_Ananya' (backend test) and 'TEST_Priya' (frontend test) in MongoDB reservations collection. Safe to leave; prefixed with TEST_ for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all current endpoints with create+persist verification. Frontend testid map is fully documented in problem statement; all selectors verified working. The reservation success toast text is 'Table secured · Reservation #<short-id>' and error toast on empty submit is 'Please complete name, phone, and date.'. Page never reaches networkidle (continuous framer-motion animations) — use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + wait_for_selector on hero-headline.
